title: BareWave: Waveform-Native Flow-Matching Text-to-Speech
title_zh: BareWave：波形原生的 Flow-Matching 文本转语音
abstract_en: Removing intermediate representations and separately trained decoding stages has become an important direction in generative modeling. In text-to-speech, however, high-quality systems are still commonly built through an intermediate acoustic representation before waveform synthesis. In this work, we present BareWave, a fully waveform-native framework for direct text-to-wave generation in flow-matching TTS. We consider this setting to raise three training challenges: raw-waveform modeling lacks a strong pretrained representational scaffold, different stages of training benefit from different noise schedules, and data-space perceptual objectives do not automatically share the temporal structure of the velocity-space flow objective. As a result, direct waveform training is hard to optimize efficiently, hard to push toward a strong final operating point with a fixed recipe, and hard to integrate effective perceptual refinement. Guided by this view, we develop a direct text-to-wave training framework that combines training-time representation alignment, staged noise scheduling, and velocity-aware perceptual alignment (VAPA), while preserving a single waveform-native inference path without pretrained components at test time. Experiments on zero-shot voice cloning show that strong intelligibility, speaker similarity, and naturalness can be achieved under a fully waveform-native inference path, supporting waveform-native flow-matching TTS as a practical direction. Project page with audio demos is available at https://barewave.github.io/.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 BareWave，一个用于 flow-matching TTS 的完全波形原生（waveform-native）框架，实现从文本到波形的直接生成，避免传统 TTS 中间声学表征与独立声码器解码阶段。作者指出直接建模原始波形面临三类训练挑战：缺乏强预训练表征支撑、不同训练阶段适合不同噪声调度，以及数据空间感知目标与速度空间 flow 目标的时间结构不天然一致。为此，BareWave 结合训练时表征对齐、分阶段噪声调度和 velocity-aware perceptual alignment（VAPA），同时在推理阶段保持单一的波形原生路径且不依赖预训练组件。零样本声音克隆实验表明，该方法在可懂度、说话人相似度和自然度上取得较强表现，验证了波形原生 flow-matching TTS 的实用潜力。
key_points_zh: 提出 BareWave：面向 flow-matching TTS 的直接 text-to-wave 框架，去除中间声学表示和单独训练的波形解码器。
分析原始波形训练的三大难点：缺少预训练表征支架、固定噪声调度难以适配不同训练阶段、感知损失与 velocity-space flow 目标结构不一致。
方法上结合训练时 representation alignment、staged noise scheduling，以及 velocity-aware perceptual alignment（VAPA）来提升优化效率与感知质量。
推理阶段保持完全 waveform-native，不使用预训练组件或额外声码器，符合端到端生成建模趋势。
在 zero-shot voice cloning 实验中展现较好的 intelligibility、speaker similarity 和 naturalness，支持直接波形生成 TTS 的可行性。

llm_assessment.comment: A technically interesting waveform-native TTS method, but its relevance to realtime multimodal agents is limited without streaming, latency, or tool-interaction framing.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该论文在波形原生TTS上有技术新意，但缺少流式、低延迟或工具交互设定，因此与实时多模态智能体的关联有限。
